tools.name: explore_color_season
tools.description: Explain a named color season or compare two named seasons. Omit season to list available seasons. Educational guidance, not a personal diagnosis; do not guess someone’s season.

tools.name: find_season_essentials
tools.description: Find curated clothing products in a specified seasonal palette and explicitly requested clothing range. Returns real product links, images and catalog prices, not live stock or a personal fit guarantee.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Explain the existing Aura DNA report, base price and required intake for an explicitly selected product. Returns the normal website purchase link where the host permits this workflow; does not create an order or charge a customer.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List the connected account’s accessible paid reports, including reports awaiting intake or processing. Ask the customer to select if more than one report could apply.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Read one owned report’s current status, available section index and website resume link. Use an orderId from list_reports; this does not generate or purchase a report.

tools.name: get_report_section
tools.description: Read a selected saved section, including palette, style, hair, Best Version or shopping essentials (plan). Requires an owned report. Missing images and historical answers must not be invented or regenerated.
